title: PETC Submission Status
description: Response from GET /api/submissions/{id} and POST /api/submissions. Used by the desktop sidecar to short-poll for the LTMS result.

submissionId.description: Cloud UUID assigned at enqueue time

state.description: PENDING: queued; IN_FLIGHT: being submitted to LTMS; ACCEPTED/REJECTED: terminal LTMS decision; DEAD: max retry attempts exhausted

certificateNo.description: LTMS-issued CEC certificate key; present only when state=ACCEPTED

rejectionReason.description: Human-readable rejection reason; present only when state=REJECTED
